create_BaseOfflineEval_subclass: create a subclass of BaseOfflineEval implementing _process_all_data, _process_used_data, _aggregate_across_instances, and get_avg_reward
ingest_batch_CBInput: ingest a batch of CBInput data with model actions to compute importance-weighted offline evaluation metrics
update_eval_model: update the frozen evaluation model with a new model copy set to eval mode
log_metrics: log offline evaluation metrics like avg_reward, frac_accepted, and accepted_rejected_reward_ratio to a LightningLogger
get_formatted_result_string: get a formatted string summarizing average reward, processed observations, and model update count
